items.reason: IL-2 is given to support the TIL cell therapy ('Following the TIL infusion, Aldesleukin (IL-2) is administered to stimulate the TILs' activity'), with no own arm or outcome; under D30-R4 it is part of the excluded therapy, leaving pembrolizumab as the only candidate.

D30-R4 treats a cytokine given to support a cell therapy as part of the excluded therapy; the record only says IL-2 is given 'to stimulate the TILs' activity'. Neither coder's value matches the ruling exactly (B's non-candidate status is right; the role label follows the excluded therapy).

With IL-2 not a candidate (D30-R4) and TIL an excluded cell therapy, pembrolizumab is the only investigational pharmacological agent, as in the manual's 'Pembrolizumab + an investigational vaccine' example.
Settled by D30-R4: IL-2 supports the TIL product ('to stimulate the TILs' activity') and is not tested as an antitumour agent in its own arm or outcome.
Same as above: D30-R4 makes IL-2 part of the excluded TIL therapy, so pembrolizumab stays experimental_monotherapy.

Cyclophosphamide and fludarabine are lymphodepleting conditioning ('a lymphodepletion regimen using cyclophosphamide and fludarabine is administered to prepare the body for the infusion'), supportive under manual R6, so not antitumour partners; IL-2 named by INN (aldesleukin, as stated in the record).

note: Whether conditioning chemotherapy belongs in combination_partners is a descriptive choice and does not affect candidate status or the primary outcome.
